answer: In this PoA network, EigenTrust computes centrality from normalized peer attestations, while temporal decay halves reputation at fixed intervals, making sustained honest service essential rather than rewarding brief activity. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity discounts isolated praise. A freshly spawned Sybil identity thus has near-zero eigenvector centrality and no trusted paths, so it cannot influence or pass consensus; cipher, vault, and kernel protections cannot replace accumulated evidence.
